utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked a time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m checking around today and should have a time soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you let me know as soon as you set it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand for the repair drive. What tools or supplies do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Gus — I think we’ll need a hammer, some nails, and maybe a wrench or two.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer and a wrench I can bring over, and I can check for some nails too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s starting up soon, and folks are already dropping off tools and spare parts. I’ll let you know if I hear anything more specific.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’d just like to know the drop-off time and where they’re storing everything. I’m trying to plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the exact drop-off time yet, but I’ll ask around and keep an eye out. As soon as I know where they’re storing everything, I’ll tell you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the repair kits at the community shed and bring the spare tools from the garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the repair kits at the community shed and bring the spare tools from the garage.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m Quinn — want me to spread the word about the repair drive? I can invite folks and get people moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That’d help a lot—please do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll start inviting folks right away and let them know it’s happening. I’ll get the word moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad you’re here. I’m putting together the repair drive list now, so tell me what needs fixing and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo — just tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details before I help? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m the one who usually shows up late, but I can help. I just need the repair drive details too, so maybe we should go over them together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works for me — let’s go over the repair drive details together so I can keep them straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup and after-school activities.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, let’s work around pickup and activities. Tell me your best windows, and I’ll fit the repair drive in there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mornings are best for me, and I’m usually free right after drop-off until about 11:30. If we need later, I can also do a short window after 3:30 once pickup is done.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard there’s a repair drive happening—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for asking — I’m just trying to gather a few basics first, like what needs fixing and what supplies folks can bring. If you’ve got a minute, I’d love your help spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can do that—I’m a bit out of the loop, but I’ll ask around and pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look and see what I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo — can you confirm you’ll let me know what you find?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need next.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thank you, Rey. I could use help sorting the donated tools and making a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Bring me the tools and I’ll make the list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to head over to the repair drive later and spread the word to a few neighbors. If you want, I can also remind people what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great — I can help remind folks too. I’ll check what supplies we still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep spreading the word and loop back once I’ve talked to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't heard any updates yet, but I'll keep an ear out while I'm running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—could you bring any basic tools you’ve got and maybe a roll of tape? I’ll repeat the plan to everyone and send the exact list too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that. I’ll bring my basic tools and a roll of tape.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I can help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah. Could you help sort the donations and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, absolutely — I can sort the donations and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Gus. Let’s meet by the garage at nine, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll see you by the garage at nine.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Mara—could you help spread the word and maybe bring any spare tools you’ve got? I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can spread the word and I’ll bring any spare tools I have. Send the details when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive organized—what’s the biggest thing we need to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We should start with the main road by the community center—it’s the spot causing the most trouble right now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense—I’ll help focus on the main road by the community center first. Want me to start lining up people and supplies?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. If you’ve got a list of fixes or neighbors who want to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa — I’ll jot down any fixes and names I hear about and pass them along. I’ll check around the block today and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll start lining up supplies and a simple sign-up sheet so we can move quickly once your list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just heard a little about the repair drive—still getting the details second-hand. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Saturday by the community hall, and they still need volunteers and a few tool donations. Do you want me to send you the time and list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—send me the time and the list. I’m still catching up, so that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help by picking up the donation boxes after school? I’m juggling the kids’ schedule, so that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that after school.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm what you’re able to bring or fix, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring basic tools, help sort donated items, and handle small repairs like tightening fixtures or patching things up.
